reason: Reading verdict on work the landing machine closed unread (auto:path, 2026-10-22). Judged from the artefact. All four named paths are on main, and the artefact commit f6587e37 is an ancestor of HEAD. I ran the suite it names today: python3 -m unittest tests.test_music_checker -> Ran 25 tests in 0.358s, OK (matches its 'all 25 final music tests pass'). The standard-MIDI claim is checkable in the code and holds: scripts/check-counterpoint.py:49 sets MIDDLE_C = 60, line 229 records that ABC C = C4 = MIDI 60 and c = C5 = MIDI 72, and the CLI takes inclusive standard-MIDI bounds per voice (--range 1=60:84, ABC C=60) rather than the older offset scheme, so the octave/range behaviour it says it corrected is the behaviour now in the file. Its own validation note also admits the honest limit - no executable external consumer exists - which I confirmed is not an overclaim by it being stated. No caller to break means the change is safe but also unexercised outside its tests.
